documentation.content: Symptom: 5xx responses exceeded 5% for five minutes with at least 20 requests per five minutes. Dashboard/logs: https://console.cloud.google.com/run/detail/us-central1/sedaia-api/metrics?project=sedaia-web-platform-api-508804. First checks: split errors by revision and inspect exception logs. Roll back when errors correlate with the active release and cannot be mitigated promptly. Owner: __NOTIFICATION_OWNER__.
